in_marathi.name: Muruganantham
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Murugan's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Muruganantham हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Muruganantham is derived from the name Murugan, a Tamil god. The name Murugan means 'Lord of the Mountains'. Anantham means 'endless' or 'eternal'. Thus, Muruganantham can be interpreted as 'Lord Murugan's endless grace'.
